questions.question: Which of the following Dynasties established the kingdom of Vijayanagara?
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Sangama Dynasty
  • Fact: Founded by brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I in 1336. It was the first of four dynasties to rule Vijayanagara.

questions.question: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded a reform association known as Brahmo Sabha which was later known as ______.
questions.solution:
• Organization: Brahmo Samaj
  • Evolution: Originally founded as Brahmo Sabha in 1828, it was a monotheistic reformist movement of the Hindu religion.

questions.question: In which of the following Indian states, Harappan cities have NOT been found?
questions.solution:
• State: Uttarakhand
  • Context: While Haryana (Rakhigarhi), Rajasthan (Kalibangan), and Gujarat (Lothal) are rich in Indus Valley sites, no major Harappan cities have been identified in the hilly terrain of Uttarakhand.

questions.question: The Ramakrishna Mission stressed the ideal of __________ through social service and selfless action.
questions.solution:
• Ideal: Salvation (Moksha)
  • Philosophy: Founded by Swami Vivekananda, the mission emphasizes that serving humanity is the highest form of worship.

questions.question: The Hindu college was established in 1791 at ______.
questions.solution:
• Location: Banaras (Varanasi)
  • History: Established by Jonathan Duncan to study and preserve Hindu laws and philosophy.

questions.question: Shyamji Krishna Varma established India House at _________ in 1905.
questions.solution:
• City: London
  • Purpose: India House was a residence for Indian students and became a hub for revolutionary activities abroad.

questions.question: “All India Muslim League” was established in 1906 at ______.
questions.solution:
• Place: Dacca (modern-day Dhaka)
  • Key Figures: Founded by Nawab Salimullah and others to protect the political rights of Indian Muslims.

questions.question: Which of the following town was built by the ruler Vijayalaya in Kaveri delta?
questions.solution:
• Town: Thanjavur
  • Fact: Vijayalaya, the founder of the Imperial Chola dynasty, captured Thanjavur and made it his capital in the 9th century.

questions.question: The Anantraj Sagar Tank was built by the ______ rulers.
questions.solution:
• Empire: Vijayanagara
  • Detail: A massive irrigation tank built to support agriculture in the semi-arid regions of the kingdom.

questions.question: The Paramhans Mandali was founded in 1840 at ___________ to work for the abolition of caste.
questions.solution:
• Location: Bombay
  • Mission: A secret socio-religious group focused on social equality and breaking caste barriers through communal meals.

questions.question: Who was the Mughal emperor, when a massive rebellion against British rule broke out in 1857?
questions.solution:
• Emperor: Bahadur Shah Zafar
  • Outcome: He was the last Mughal ruler; the British exiled him to Rangoon after the revolt failed.

questions.question: Which of the following city of India was a coastal settlement where ships unloaded goods from distant lands between 2200 and 1900 years ago?
questions.solution:
• City: Arikamedu
  • Significance: An ancient Indo-Roman trading station near Puducherry where Roman pottery and coins have been excavated.

questions.question: The Revolutionary Socialist Party was established in ____.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1940
  • Context: A Marxist–Leninist party in India that broke away from the Congress Socialist Party.

questions.question: Harihara and Bukka established an independent state in Karnataka and established the capital city Vijayanagar on the banks of river _____________ in 1336.
questions.solution:
• River: Tungabhadra
  • Significance: The river provided a natural defense and a perennial water source for the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.

questions.question: Which of the following led English company in Battle of Plassey (1757)?
questions.solution:
• Leader: Robert Clive
  • Battle: This victory against Siraj-ud-Daulah laid the foundation of British political rule in India.

questions.question: Which of the following combinations of ‘Ruler - Predecessor’ is correct with respect to the Delhi Sultanate?
questions.solution:
• Correct Pair: Alauddin Khalji – Jalaluddin Khalji
  • Fact: Alauddin was the nephew and son-in-law of Jalaluddin, whom he assassinated to take the throne.

questions.question: The word Manuscripts derived from which of the following language?
questions.solution:
• Origin: Latin
  • Etymology: From 'manu' (hand) and 'scriptus' (written).

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Treaty of Salbai signed?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1782
  • Impact: It ended the First Anglo-Maratha War and established a period of peace between the British and Marathas for 20 years.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding king Harshavardhana?
questions.option_1: Harshacharita is a biography written on Harshavardhana
questions.option_3: Xuan Zang spent a lot of time at Harsha's court
questions.option_4: Harshavardhana ruled nearly about 1400 years ago
questions.solution:
• Incorrect Fact: Harishena was the court poet of Harsha.
  • Correction: Harishena was the court poet of Samudragupta. Harsha's court poet was Banabhatta (author of Harshacharita).

questions.question: The proposed Rowlett Act of 1919 allowed detention of political prisoners without trial for________.
questions.solution:
• Duration: Two years
  • Nature: Known as the 'Black Act', it gave the government powers to crush political activities without any legal trial.

questions.question: Ishwarchandra vidyasagar set up school for girls at ______.
questions.solution:
• City: Calcutta
  • Role: A pioneer of women's education; he was closely associated with the Bethune School.

questions.question: During which of the following period Ostriches were found in India?
questions.solution:
• Era: Palaeolithic
  • Evidence: Ostrich eggshells have been found at sites like Patne in Maharashtra dating back over 25,000 years.

questions.question: When did the Mongol ruler Genghis Khan die?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1227
  • History: The founder of the Mongol Empire died during a campaign against the Western Xia.

questions.question: Which company has set up a factory on the banks of river Hugli in 1651?
questions.solution:
• Company: English East India Company
  • Context: This was the first English factory in Bengal, established during the reign of Shah Jahan.

questions.question: In which state is the Maihar court where Baba Allauddin Khan was a musician?
questions.solution:
• State: Madhya Pradesh
  • Music: Baba Allauddin Khan founded the Maihar Gharana, one of the most prominent schools of Hindustani classical music.
